summary: Teva's Dutch finance subsidiaries (Teva Finance II, III and IV) filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for a multi-tranche senior notes offering: euro-denominated 2033 and 2036 notes plus USD 2032, 2034 and 2037 notes, all unconditionally guaranteed by Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited. Amounts, coupons and maturities are left blank pending pricing. Notes are redeemable at make-whole, or par from the applicable Par Call Date, with a 101% change-of-control repurchase right. This is a routine debt capital-markets takedown, not a special situation; watch final size, coupons and proceeds use.
